title: I visited a mall that wasn’t “mine” for the very first time.
content: While the inside of the mall in my world changes from time to time, it’s always familiar. It’s the same type of building, same location in the world, some things haven’t changed in 15 years. I have never visited another mall. I took a nap today and found myself excited to be in the mall. I very quickly became insanely disoriented. For some reason, I knew I was in Georgia (never been, nowhere near where I’m from). I remember there was some country style wallpaper in the restrooms and parts of the mall itself. But I remember best getting lost and trying to get out and an old lady working at a chik fil a was really short with me but told me the way out in a thick southern accent. I was able to get out and found myself in a dark and dangerous parking lot in the rain. I felt like people were coming for me. Nothing too crazy just wanted to see if anyone else has visited a mall other than their “own”
